dayLines: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a farmer's tan about A person, maybe 20s, with a limp. The retelling is already better than the event.
💧 A person, maybe 20s, with a limp returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a farmer's tan returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut returns with water: +4 clean.
📖 A man, maybe 30s, with restless hands is re-packing the bundle, checking each thing twice before it goes back in.
A woman, maybe 40s, with a wiry build is sweeping the corners out, muttering at the dust.

"Hey." A person, maybe 20s, with a gap-toothed grin settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 20s, with a gap-toothed grin.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 20s, with a limp is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
A person, maybe 20s, with a limp is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 79/100)
A woman, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair had the day of their life — 1240 kcal. Two days of food from one person.
Anna and Lamia lingered over the fire together.
Anna and Lamia lingered over the fire together.
Lucas and Dmitri lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Sharpened stick at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Lifebound Vestments at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
📓 Journal: the woman in her 30s, with grey-streaked hair taught the woman in her 40s, with a wiry build Herbal Medicine.
🤒 Lucas is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. A woman, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair is already boiling water. It's handled.
Anna sits with Lucas — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.
Anna sits with Lucas — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.
🔧 Technique learned: tick removal.
A woman, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair watches you scratch at your ankle and shakes their head. “Here — tweezers at the head, steady pull, don’t twist. Like this.” (You learned tick removal.)
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

A man, maybe 30s, with restless hands watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
A man, maybe 30s, with restless hands plants themself in front of you. "This isn't working. You know it, I know it. Say it out loud."
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with grey-streaked hair speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Anna," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Anna." You'll remember that.

...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a farmer's tan speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.

— Still water, cattails —
Your boots sink and sigh. Frogs go silent in a widening ring around you.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.

Cheryl has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: A woman, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes passes around a soft-trunked small tree with a crown of huge lobed leaves and melon-like fruit hanging below. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
★ IDENTIFIED: Papaya. Soft trunk, big lobed leaves, melon fruit. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Papaya too.

Anna spends the afternoon with the small understory tree, big drooping leaves, mango-sized green-yellow fruit — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Pawpaw — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Pawpaw. Large drooping leaves, custard-like fruit in fall. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 You see it again in your mind: small understory tree, big drooping leaves, mango-sized green-yellow fruit. Anna's words land on the memory like a label. Pawpaw. Of course.
Lamia was watching. Now they know Pawpaw too.
Fernando traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
A person, maybe 20s, with a limp: "tall serrated leaves on square stems that sting your hand when you grab them is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."

sayLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.

📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.

📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
